Antecedentes Clínicos:
Traumatismo.
Hallazgos:
Discreto foco edema óseo en relación a la superficie articular tibio peroneo proximal de la tibia,
probablemente secundaria condropatía focal. No hay otras alteraciones de señal de la médula ósea.
Aumento de señal con discreta pérdida de la continuidad de las fibras centrales del LCA. LCP y ligamentos
colaterales sin alteraciones que consignar.
Rotura compleja con componente principal horizontal oblicuo del cuerno posterior y parte de la raíz meniscal
posterior del menisco medial con segmento que se insinúa a la región intercondílea posterior.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Condropatía
superficial la faceta medial de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular. Ganglión quístico polilobulado de la región posterosuperior de la rodilla, en íntima
relación con el receso gastrocnemio medial semimembranoso, no complicado.
Tendones cuadricipital, la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Impresión:
Aumento de señal con probable pérdida parcial de la continuidad las fibras centrales del LCA, correlacionar
con estabilidad clínica.
Rotura compleja del cuerno posterior y parte de la raíz meniscal posterior del menisco medial.
Discreto foco de edema óseo, probablemente secundaria condropatía focal tibio peronea proximal a la
superficie tibial.
Condropatía rotuliana superficial.
Leve derrame articular.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal

Medyal femorotibyal kompartman osteoartriti tam kat eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve subkortikal medüller fibrovasküler değişikliklerle karekterize. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunun dışında normal. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı orta derecede artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Medyal menisküs gövde-arka boynuzunu ilgilendiren geniş doku kaybı ile birlikte olan kompleks dejeneratif yırtık. Lateral menisküs normal. Gastrokinemyus-semimembranozus bursiti minimal kalınlıkta; sızdırıyor. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Diz medyalinde cilt altında genişlemiş yüzeyel venöz yapılar izleniyor.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normaldir. Medial menisküs diz ekleminde 3.5 mm mediale ekstrüdedir. Menisküs posterior horn ve gövde kesimde grade III dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial kollateral ligamanda periligamentöz ödem izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patella medial fasette subkondral alanda 10x4.5 mm boyutlu osteokondral defekt izlenmiştir.Lateral fasette 7.3 mm boyutlu osteokondral defekt alanı izlenmektedir. Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde minimal sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondral skleroz izlenmiştir. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda belirgin incelmeler izlenmiştir.Popliteal fossada 3x1 cm boyutlu Baker kisti izlenmiştir.SONUÇ:Gonartroz .Medial menisküste hafif mediale ekstrüzyon.Grade III meniskopati .Suprapatellar bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit.Medial kollateral ligamanda grade I sprain.Popliteal fossada Baker kisti.Patella medial fasetde osteokondral defekt.

Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Tendones cuadricipital, la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales. Leve engrosamiento y aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin
signos de rotura.
Discreto edema de las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Laminar cantidad de líquido entre los tendones de la pata de ganso y el cóndilo femoral medial.
Impresión:
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial y de la región posteromedial de la rodilla.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Diz eklemindeki bikompartmantal osteoartrit patellofemoral ve femoral tibyal eklemlerde olup, kondral kalınlığın %50'sini aşmayan incelme, milimetrik boyutlu subkortikal medüller fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve milimetrik marjinal osteofitler ile karakterize. Lateral menisküs komple diskoid özellikte. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesindeki dejenerasyona arka boynuzdan gövdesine uzanan horizontal longitudinal üst ve alt eklem yüzeylerine ulaşan bileşenleri bulunan kompleks yırtık eşlik ediyor. Medyal menisküs kısmen meniskotibyal resese deplase. İç yan bağın çevresi ödemli. Çapraz ve yan bağlar bunun dışında korunmuş. Posterior oblik bağ ödemli. Posteromedyal köşe yapıları bunun dışında korunmuş. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

Right knee MRI without contrast:

INDICATION: Rule out right knee meniscal tear.

COMPARISON: No prior for comparison.

FINDINGS:

No significant effusion. No loose body.

Anterior compartment:
Overall mildly chondrosis with small fissures on the lateral and medial facets of the patella less than 50% of the thickness. Area of subchondral sclerosis on the lateral facet. Patellar and quadriceps tendons intact. Retinacula are intact. Hoffa fat pad unremarkable.

Medial compartment:
Mild chondrosis. Presence of a small meniscal flounce in the anterior body of medial meniscus without definitive tear. Capsular meniscal interface intact. Medial collateral ligament intact. Pes anserine unremarkable. Moderate insertional tendinopathy within the semimembranosus tendon.

Lateral compartment:
Mild chondrosis no significant meniscal tear. Lateral collateral ligament intact. Biceps femoris tendon intact. Iliotibial band intact. Popliteus tendon is intact.

Intercondylar compartment:
Mild cystic changes within the tibial eminence and mild high signal intensity within the anterior cruciate ligament and could be in keeping with intraligamentous beginning degenerative mucoid changes. Posterior cruciate ligament intact.

Multiple varicose veins on the medial aspect of the knee in the subcutaneous tissues.

CONCLUSION:
1. Mild to moderate patellofemoral chondrosis.
2. Semimembranosus insertional tendinosis without tear. No discrete ligament or meniscal tear identified.
3. Multiple varicose veins to the medial aspect of the knee in the subcutaneous tissue.

MRI LEFT KNEE:

INDICATION:    [Age] male complaining of left knee pain and swelling. Ultrasound shows focal tear of the lateral collateral ligament versus ligament sprain and likely tear of the medial and lateral meniscus. Joint effusion in the suprapatellar recess and Baker's cyst. Recommended by radiologist.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

There is mild thickening and increased T2 signal in the proximal fibers of the patellar tendon. Findings are consistent with mild patellar tendinosis. Quadriceps and patellofemoral ligaments are intact and appear unremarkable.

The articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint demonstrates mild chondral fraying at the patellar apex and also within the femoral trochlea but overall cartilage is reasonably well-maintained. The TT-TG distance is within normal limits.

There is mild non-surfacing signal seen in the posterior horn of medial meniscus peripherally. Involving posterior horn near the posterior root attachment of medial meniscus there is mild apical truncation and fraying of the meniscus consistent with a subtle radial tear. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment demonstrates regions of chondral fraying and thinning with a few subcortical cysts seen within the weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle in keeping with moderate chondrosis.

There is a subtle tear in the lateral meniscus involving anterior horn and anterior body in keeping with the radial tear in this region. There is also a horizontal signal in keeping with a horizontal tear extending into the anterior horn of lateral meniscus. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment demonstrates chondral fraying and thinning but is reasonably well-maintained. Findings are consistent with moderate chondrosis. Minimal degenerative spurring to the lateral joint compartment is noted.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including the IT band, the fibular collateral ligament, the biceps femoris tendon and popliteus tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is a small Baker's cyst. There is edema and fluid seen around the pes anserine tendons consistent with pes anserine bursitis.

There is a small knee effusion. Mild reactive synovitis is noted.

Marrow signal is within normal limits.

INTERPRETATION: 

Mild tricompartmental chondrosis with early degenerative spurring to the lateral joint margin.

Subtle meniscal tears to the lateral and medial menisci as described.

Small Baker's cyst.

Pes anserine bursitis.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain. [REDACTED]. Patellar dislocation. Prior history of MCL grade 3 sprain and patellar dislocation (less severe) in [DATE] and [DATE]
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Mild marrow edema along the peripheral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle, likely represents contusion from a recent lateral patellar dislocation. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Cartilage heterogeneity along the median patellar ridge and lateral patellar facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Low grade 2 sprain of the MPFL and medial patellar retinacula.
Patellofemoral tracking: Edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Lateral patellar tilt and translation . Patella alta configuration. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 19 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Findings of patellofemoral maltracking with osseous contusion along the lateral femoral condyle suggesting a recent lateral patellar dislocation, as described above.
2.	Low grade 2 sprain of the MPFL and medial patellar retinacula.
3.	Moderate knee joint effusion.
4.	Low-grade patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.
